local_tests.hermes_provider: deterministic local fixture, no model inference

ci.scope: Locked install, documentation and license checks, automated integrations, 220 reference cases per job, clean tarball installation and CLI/MCP/dashboard checks

stress.workload: 64 same-run retry requests per invoice across 1000 worlds, up to 64 concurrent HTTP workers, real MCP reads, restart readback
stress.scope: Single local server. Does not claim hosted multi-tenant scale or model safety.

limitations: Single local server stress workload, not hosted capacity.
Installed Hermes runtime used a deterministic provider, not an authenticated model campaign.
Hosted CI does not replace independent human onboarding.
Publication privacy and remaining third-party tool review are separate.
